_comment: Korea Customs Service open-API endpoints (data.go.kr). All require a free
service key: register at https://www.data.go.kr (instant, no cost), request
use of each dataset, then set the env var DATA_GO_KR_API_KEY (use the
'decoded' key). The monthly item-trade endpoint below is stable and
documented. The 10/20-day flash endpoints publish on the 11th, 21st and
1st; their operation paths are set from the dataset's API doc page —
if KCS revises them, update 'url' here, nothing else changes.
Exports flash dataset: search data.go.kr for '수출 주요품목별 10일 단위 잠정치'.
Portal view of the same numbers: https://tradedata.go.kr

flash_exports_10day._setup: Paste the request URL from the dataset's API doc page into 'url' and align param names; until then this feed is skipped with a notice.

flash_imports_10day._setup: Dataset 15157901; paste the request URL from its API doc page into 'url'.
